provenance.registrations: TaskCreate consumes canonical 24-byte TaskDesc records; ModeRequest consumes canonical 16-byte Mode records. Callback tuples and ASCII names identify regional registrations. EU Monsgage callbacks are explicitly exposed within existing opaque native code. Message face/wait tasks form a real three-record array. Only absent EU link-exchange tasks omit records; work-size and callback differences use field-level guards.
provenance.names: Each bounded ASCII name is directly referenced by one or more verified registration records. Shared name addresses have one C owner. String bounds end at their first NUL.
